latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the Instagram Marketing Generator skill.
- Convert e-commerce product URLs into engaging, ready-to-post Instagram content.
- Automatically extract product details via SkillBoss API Hub or manual fallback.
- Generate image/video briefs, scroll-stopping captions with CTAs, and hashtag strategies.
- Includes adaptable templates, format-specific frameworks, and posting best practices for Feed, Carousel, Story, and Reel content.
- Reference guides and templates provided for different product categories and campaign strategies.
